title: EigDiff: Eigensample Diffusion - or how to significantly reduce training dataset size with marginal performance variation?
abstract: arXiv:2610.20999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models are notoriously expensive to train, requiring large-scale datasets to learn how to gradually reverse the noise from images over multiple small denoising steps. Current approaches focus on distilling the number of diffusion steps, neglecting potential redundancies of the training data. In this paper, we explore the potential of harnessing eigensamples to train diffusion models on significantly smaller datasets, while preserving model performance. To mitigate the sensitivity to affine transformations of eigenimages, we harness the latent space of a pre-trained CLIP model. We next compute latent eigenvectors by performing principal component analysis (PCA) in CLIP space. Further, we employ eigenvectors as reference points to guide the selection of a representative training set comprising comprising both exemplars (images whose embeddings are closest to eigenvectors) and diverse images. translated_title: EigDiff：特征样本扩散——或如何在性能几乎不变的情况下显著缩减训练数据集规模？
translated_abstract: 扩散模型的训练成本极高，需要大规模数据集来学习如何在多个小的去噪步骤中逐步还原图像。当前的方法主要聚焦于蒸馏扩散步数，而忽视了训练数据中潜在的冗余。本文探索了利用特征样本在显著更小的数据集上训练扩散模型的潜力，同时保持模型性能。为了缓解特征图像对仿射变换的敏感性，我们利用预训练CLIP模型的潜在空间。随后，我们通过在CLIP空间中执行主成分分析（PCA）来计算潜在特征向量。进一步地，我们将这些特征向量作为参考点，用以指导选择由样本代表（即嵌入最接近特征向量的图像）和多样化图像组成的代表性训练集。我们通过全面的实验……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出EigDiff方法，在预训练CLIP模型的潜在空间中执行PCA获取特征向量，并以此为指导选取由样本代表与多样化图像构成的代表性训练子集，从而在性能几乎不变的前提下大幅缩减扩散模型的训练数据集规模。
en_tdlr: EigDiff performs PCA in the latent space of a pre-trained CLIP model and uses the resulting eigenvectors as reference points to select a representative training subset of exemplars and diverse images, significantly reducing diffusion model training dataset size with only marginal performance variation.
